internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Due to Resource Exhaustion
internal.body:
At 11:40 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. Diagnosis identified resource exhaustion caused by the recently enabled adHighCpu flag, which led to high CPU usage and degraded performance. The flag was disabled at 12:00 UTC, resulting in recovery of service latency to normal levels as verified by monitoring metrics. The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact.

Timeline:
- 11:40:23 Alert received for high latency
- 12:00:04 Diagnosis confirmed resource exhaustion linked to adHighCpu flag
- 12:00:05 Flag disabled after approval
- 12:00:05 Recovery verified with latency metrics returning to normal

Severity: SEV3

Action Taken:
- Disabled the adHighCpu flag to alleviate CPU resource exhaustion and restore service performance.

external.title: Service Latency Issue Resolved
external.body: Between 11:40 and 12:00 UTC on 2026-11-08, the ad service experienced elevated latency impacting performance. The issue was identified and resolved by adjusting internal configurations, restoring normal service operation. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

output.summary: High latency in the ad service caused by resource exhaustion due to a recently enabled configuration flag was resolved by disabling the flag.
output.impact: Customers experienced increased latency in the ad service for approximately 20 minutes, potentially affecting ad delivery performance.
output.root_cause: The root cause was resource exhaustion in the ad service triggered by the adHighCpu flag, which caused high CPU usage and degraded latency performance.
output.resolution: The adHighCpu flag was disabled, which immediately restored normal CPU usage and service latency to acceptable levels.

lessons.lesson: Be cautious when enabling flags that affect CPU usage; monitor closely for performance degradation and have a rollback plan ready.
lessons.applies_when: When a flag known to increase CPU usage is enabled in the ad service.

action_items: Implement automated monitoring alerts specifically for CPU usage spikes related to feature flags.
Develop a quick rollback procedure for flags that impact resource consumption.
